from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/services')
result = []
for directory in sorted(root.glob('*sqlite*')):
    if not directory.is_dir():
        continue
    for path in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
        if not path.is_file() or 'raw' in path.relative_to(directory).parts:
            continue
        name = path.name.lower()
        if name.endswith(('.zip.b64', '.zip.base64')) or any(term in name for term in ('rights', 'provenance', 'license', 'licence', 'manifest', 'archive-verification')):
            data = path.read_bytes()
            result.append({'path': path.as_posix(), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256_of_stored_file': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
out = Path('products/services/sqlite-itch-paid-download/paid-archive-source-index.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Selected SQLite service directories. Paths are navigation. A filename or stored-file hash does not establish a redistribution grant, decoded ZIP identity, or execution.', 'files': result}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': out.as_posix(), 'matching_files': len(result)}))
